title: Read-only MODFLOW/XMI prepared-solve state forensics for persistent path memory
question: Which state exposed through the existing MODFLOW6 6.8.0 XMI/memory-manager surface differs between the G21B FRESH and HISTORY prepared solves when the outer-2 affine response is bitwise identical and XOLD is fixed, and does any nontrivial solver/package state remain path-dependent after the 12-call fixed-response tail?
snapshot_contract: Use the exact G21B FRESH and HISTORY construction and frozen outer-2 HCOF/RHS.
Open one prepared solve per arm; never write through any returned pointer.
Take read-only copies of all preregistered memory-manager probes at outer-2 tail entry, at the first MODFLOW convergence report for that tail, and after tail call 12.
Require every required probe to resolve through get_var_address/get_value_ptr. A missing required probe falsifies the planned forensic surface and must be preserved rather than silently dropped.
Record dtype, shape, bitwise digest/equality and maximum absolute numerical difference for each FRESH/HISTORY probe pair at matched forensic stages.
Treat bookkeeping counters separately from physical/solver/package state because FRESH and HISTORY intentionally execute different numbers of solve calls.
Require XOLD bitwise equal between arms and unchanged within each arm.
Require API HCOF/RHS bitwise equal between arms throughout the outer-2 fixed-response tail.
Do not infer causality solely from a differing derived array; classify only the location of observable path dependence.

classification_rules.solver_history_visible: At call 12, one or more non-bookkeeping SLN_1 state probes other than values trivially identical to current X differ between FRESH and HISTORY.
classification_rules.package_state_visible: At call 12, one or more NPF/STO dynamic state probes differ between FRESH and HISTORY.
classification_rules.current_iterate_only_or_derived: At call 12, X differs as in G21B, while solver history probes are equal or explainable as direct current-iterate copies and package differences are only state-dependent quantities recomputed from X; no distinct exposed accumulator is identified.
classification_rules.mixed_or_unresolved: Observed probe pattern does not support one bounded classification.

gates: Reproduce the G21B fresh/history call-12 head offset within 1e-12 m of the persisted G21B value.
All required probes resolve and can be copied read-only.
XOLD is bitwise fixed within each arm and bitwise equal between arms.
Outer-2 API HCOF/RHS remain bitwise identical.
No pointer returned by XMI is mutated by the diagnostic.
Emit complete per-probe comparisons at tail entry, first convergence and call 12.
Classify observable state location using the preregistered rules without proposing a reset or changing convergence semantics.
pass_interpretation: PASS is a forensic classification only. It may identify exposed solver/package state associated with path dependence or may show that no distinct exposed memory beyond current-iterate/derived state is visible. It does not prove causality and does not authorize modification of any MODFLOW state.
fail_interpretation: Preserve failure. Do not drop unresolved probes, alter MODFLOW tolerances, change the 12-call tail, or add state mutation to obtain a cleaner classification.
